name: Delivery spike on a strong up-day
author: claude
hypothesis: A 2%+ up-day closing near the high with delivery 2 standard deviations above normal, above the 50-day in a healthy market, shows institutions buying and follows through for a week.
filter: deliv_z > {z} and ret_1 > {up} and close_loc_1 > 0.7 and dist_ma50 > 0 and nifty_above_ma200 == 1 and not avoid
